_about: Runs each machine's model (models/<machine>.json) is built from; see analysis/model.py and results/README.md. keep: all | sync (drop pipelined GPU rows) | sync-no-cpu-e (also drop CPU-E rows). cache_states: the cache-state probe runs (calib_filter --cache; every state against the cold rows of the same runs) -> models/<machine>.json cache_states; slc_mb: the system level cache, for the footprint bands.

op_notes.filter_count: pipelined GPU: the linear fit implies ~1200 GB/s, above the 819 GB/s DRAM peak; measured per size it peaks at 798 GB/s (2^24); over the largest morsels (large_n) 801 GB/s, which the overlap form uses. Quote measured values or large_n, not the line
op_notes.agg_sum: pipelined GPU: the linear fit implies ~1200 GB/s; measured per size it peaks at 795 GB/s (2^24); over the largest morsels (large_n) 806 GB/s, which the overlap form uses. Quote measured values or large_n, not the line
op_notes.agg_group/G=7: pipelined GPU: the linear fit implies ~990 GB/s; measured per size it peaks at 778 GB/s (2^25); over the largest morsels (large_n) 787 GB/s, which the overlap form uses. Quote measured values or large_n, not the line
op_notes.agg_group/G=2526: pipelined GPU: the linear fit implies ~970 GB/s; measured per size it peaks at 776 GB/s (2^25); over the largest morsels (large_n) 790 GB/s, which the overlap form uses. Quote measured values or large_n, not the line
op_notes.join_probe/nation_probe: pipelined GPU: per-batch overhead dominates up to the largest size (2^20) and batches overlap on the 6 MB probe column, so beta is not identified (cv 70%); measured peak 228 GB/s
op_notes.join_build/orders_build: gpu-cold is bimodal between runs at 2^20-2^21 (2^20: 615 us in round 1, 1177 us in rounds 2-3); gpu-warm is stable
